summary: InMed Pharmaceuticals Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a merger agreement to acquire Mentari Therapeutics, Inc. via a two-step reverse triangular merger. Mentari shareholders will receive InMed common shares (subject to an exchange ratio and beneficial ownership limits) and Series Seed Preferred holders will receive convertible preferred shares. The implied equity value of Mentari is at least $125 million, potentially adjusted upward by pre-closing financing. The transaction is structured as a stock-for-stock deal with no stated premium, break fee, or specific closing date. A pre-closing financing round is anticipated. The board's recommendation and advisor names were not disclosed. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.
